answer: One concrete defense is a per-agent stake that is slashed when a colluding cluster is caught. Each new agent must lock real value before it can vote or earn, and its record is sealed to the ledger like rings in a cedar, so wiping an identity just repeats the same payment. When many look-alike agents submit identical work, the system reads that redundancy as a signal of fakery and burns their stakes. A Sybil farm thus needs a fresh deposit per puppet and loses it on detection, a thousand identities costing a thousand rents, far more than honest work on the terrace.
